audit.whatIsWrong: tldr, report[0].t, dontsFull[2].t and report[11].t all call Leona 'his' — Leona is female per champ-gender.js.
audit.why: The owner is addressed as 'you'; the third-person pronoun refers to the enemy, and Leona is on the female list.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Zenith Blade as matchup-defining with no cooldown number.
audit.why: Zenith Blade's cooldown drops fast with rank (12/10.5/9/7.5/6s) — worth stating since a maxed E is down for only 6 seconds, which changes how long a punish window actually lasts.
audit.corrected: Added the rank-scaling cooldown to breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.why: packet.defects flags the winRate (53.43% Taric) vs the level chart (Leona favoured stages 1-5) as a contradiction, but this is normal lane shape, not an error: Leona's point-and-click E-Q chain wins early levels and Taric's Radiance/chain-stun kit overtakes from two items on, which is exactly what phases[]/win[] already describe. Left the chart as-is.
